digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass1 container criterion routing and rubric
propositions: Plan review certified tickets with mutually unsatisfiable acceptance criteria across parent and children without detecting the contradiction, forcing late corrections and full re-reviews triggered by stale attestations.

No existing criterion owns the concern of whether a ticket's own AC and its Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations are jointly satisfiable — COH disclaims within-section contradictions, E1 covers mapping, F1 covers measurability, but none tests set-quantification satisfiability.

The sibling roster passed to G3's child-coverage audit contains only ticket ids and titles, insufficient to discharge the test that "NO sibling in the roster covers" a parent AC, causing the finding to fire never.

Three independent copies of the sibling roster-building expression exist across pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, and eval_solver.py, preventing unified change and corrupting dogfooding data if they diverge.
The sibling roster is sent per-pairing in instructions rather than once in a byte-stable prefix, preventing caching and re-sending acceptance-criteria data with each child pairing.
The parent_tokens prefix estimate omits the roster's token cost, risking bin-packing and warm-gate decisions to exceed the window budget once the roster moves into the prefix.
